periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis is oriented vertically at approximately 80 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, with a slight inward inclination at the superior margin.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The eye patches are vertically elongated ovals with a visual aspect ratio of approximately 1.7:1 height to width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The patches exhibit a downward taper, with the lower half appearing narrower than the upper half and the centroid positioned slightly above the vertical midpoint.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior boundary of the dark band forms a broad, shallow U-shaped curve across the upper back.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The horizontal gap between the medial edges of the ears is approximately 1.3 times the maximum width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior edges of the ears are characterized by a smooth, semi-circular convex curvature with no visible flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: The white fur across the head and dorsal region displays a distinct yellowish-brown chromatic shift compared to the lower facial and neck regions.
